act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

classification.offence: Public servant unlawfully engaging in trade.
classification.punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both, or community service.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Public servant unlawfully engaging in trade
section.html: Whoever, being a public servant, and being legally bound as such public servant not to engage in trade, engages in trade, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both or with community service.
